title: humanoid_olympics round input
description: A balanced six-event Humanoid Olympics meet. Every evaluation contains the same number of attempts of each discipline and the same public, balanced launch conditions.

seed.description: Platform round identifier. It is score-neutral in the fixed v0.1 launch meet.

instances_per_event.description: Four attempts of each of the six disciplines: the fixed 24-attempt launch meet.

deadline_ms.description: Fixed per-action HTTP deadline for the launch version.

wind_max_ms.description: Fixed maximum round-derived ground-level wind speed in m/s.

record_history.description: The fixed launch meet records replayable history for all 24 attempts.

history_stride.description: The fixed launch history keeps every second 50 Hz control frame.
